description.narrative: Oxfam (consortium lead) and CNV Internationaal (lead partner) have participated actively in the RSPO, focusing their efforts on promoting and strengthening the principles and criteria (P<(>&<)>C), as well as the protocols and guidelines related to human rightsandcommunities involved with and often affected by palm oil operations, including workers, indigenous communities, women, and human rights defenders, as well as human rights organizations. The effective implementation of standards, policies, and protocols requires the active and qualified participation of these groups, who are familiar with these tools and know how to use them. Effective implementation also requires the RSPO and the companies auditing its standards to be familiar with the social movements, labor unions, andhuman rights organizations, to ask for their assessments in certifying or evaluating a company. In this regard, the objectives of Oxfam and CNV Internationaal in their work in RSPO are very much aligned with the objectives of the RSPO outreach program, which seeks to ensure informed and qualified participation from communities and workers of the RSPO at all levels, establishing stronger linkages with the RSPO through intermediary organizations, and for civil society organizations (CSOs) and local governments to be aware of the RSPO and its mechanisms, facilitating active and informed community participation in the implementation of sustainability efforts by producers and palm oil companies.

participating-org.narrative: The role of the "Christelijk Nationaal Vakverbond, CNV" ( Christian National Trade Union) is to represent the interests of their members in the field of work and income. With an open, professional and personal style they serve primarily the CNV members. The CNV finds inspiration in Christian social thinking and has its roots in the Bible. From there, CNV believes that every human strives for and aims to "reach his/her destination". In our performance-oriented and increasingly complex society the CNV wants to contribute bymaking people resilient and agile in carrying out their work. The CNV strives for a society in which people have equal opportunities as much as possible, and sustainability is a central concept. Staff, volunteers and members of the CNVturn their talents to transform these ideals into customized services, appealing products and striking actions. To achieve this, the CNV maintains an ongoing dialogue with members, society and international organizations in the field of human and labor.
